name: plugin.paperless_ngx
description: Paperless-NGX document ingestion, hybrid search, and RAG integration bridge

entrypoints.name: paperless_ingest_and_await
entrypoints.description: Upload document, await background consumption, and return verified IngestionReceipt with hydrated document metadata

parameters.name: file_path
parameters.description: Local path to document file to ingest

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Optional override document title

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Optional list of tags to assign

parameters.name: correspondent
parameters.description: Optional correspondent to assign

parameters.name: document_type
parameters.description: Optional document type to assign

parameters.name: timeout_seconds
parameters.description: Maximum seconds to wait for consumption completion (default: 30.0)

entrypoints.name: paperless_ask_grounded_rag
entrypoints.description: Query paperless_ai RAG chat endpoint and return answer with fully hydrated cited document records for provenance verification

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Question to answer from document corpus

parameters.name: document_ids
parameters.description: Optional list of document IDs to restrict search scope to

entrypoints.name: paperless_search_documents
entrypoints.description: Search documents across Paperless-NGX using Tantivy full-text search with metadata filters

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Full-text search query string

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Optional list of tag names to filter by

parameters.name: correspondent
parameters.description: Optional correspondent name to filter by

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of documents to return (default: 10)

entrypoints.name: paperless_get_document
entrypoints.description: Retrieve detailed metadata and OCR content snippet for a document ID

parameters.name: document_id
parameters.description: Numeric ID of the document in Paperless-NGX

entrypoints.name: paperless_post_document
entrypoints.description: Upload a document file to Paperless-NGX for background asynchronous consumption

parameters.name: file_path
parameters.description: Local path to document file to ingest

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Optional override document title

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Optional list of tags to assign

parameters.name: correspondent
parameters.description: Optional correspondent to assign

parameters.name: document_type
parameters.description: Optional document type to assign

entrypoints.name: paperless_ask_rag
entrypoints.description: Query paperless_ai RAG chat endpoint to answer questions with document citations

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Question to answer from document corpus

parameters.name: document_ids
parameters.description: Optional list of document IDs to restrict search scope to

entrypoints.name: paperless_get_task_status
entrypoints.description: Check status, progress, and result of an asynchronous consumption task

parameters.name: task_id
parameters.description: UUID string of the Celery consumption task
